name: JurisGrid
summary: Free research hub of 541 Indian legaltech, verification and public-data providers across 15 sectors. CC BY 4.0 JSON; llms.txt and markdown twins; no login.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (queue #49 was submitted by an AI agent for the JurisGrid team; no legal entity or contact email is named on the cited pages). JurisGrid is a free, no-login research hub at https://jurisgrid.com/ (HTTP 200) that briefs India's legaltech, background-verification and public-data providers, including whether they have a public API or MCP server. Structured files https://jurisgrid.com/data/providers.json and https://jurisgrid.com/data/scores.json both return HTTP 200 and declare license "CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): credit JurisGrid and link to https://jurisgrid.com/", with generated 2026-11-13T06:59:13Z (2026-11-13 07:59:13 Europe/Stockholm) and providers count 541. llms.txt (HTTP 200, reviewed 13 Nov 2026) matches those figures: 541 providers across 15 sectors, with scores for the 284 that sell data, and 53 listed providers publishing a public REST API and 19 a public MCP server. The homepage markdown twin https://jurisgrid.com/index.md (HTTP 200) still has key-fact bullets dated 11 Nov 2026 that say 531 providers, 46 public APIs and 17 public MCP servers — those bullets lag the 13 Nov JSON and llms.txt; this entry uses the JSON/llms.txt figures. Methodology (https://jurisgrid.com/methodology/ and /methodology/index.md, both HTTP 200, frontmatter reviewed 2026-11-13) states the nine-criteria 0–100 rubric, that the score measures how reachable and usable a provider's data is and does not test accuracy, and that "The licence covers the data files; page text and design are not covered unless a page says otherwise." The same methodology page also says "this release was reviewed on 10 Nov 2026" in the freshness section, which disagrees with its 13 Nov frontmatter — the inconsistency is recorded rather than choosing one date as the sole review date. Every page has a markdown twin (add index.md, or send Accept: text/markdown). Listing a correction or a new provider via /submit/ is free and needs no account. https://jurisgrid.com/terms and /privacy return HTTP 404; none were used as sources. No public GitHub repository was found on the cited pages. The site itself has no MCP or OpenAPI; agents read llms.txt, the JSON files, and markdown twins. No signup was used.

agent_access.notes: No hosted MCP or OpenAPI was found for JurisGrid itself. llms.txt, https://jurisgrid.com/data/providers.json and /data/scores.json are public with no login (HTTP 200). Official wording: every page has a markdown twin (add index.md, or send Accept: text/markdown). The JSON license is CC BY 4.0 with credit to JurisGrid and a link to https://jurisgrid.com/. Homepage index.md key facts still say 531 providers as of 11 Nov 2026; llms.txt and the JSON files say 541 as of 13 Nov 2026. No account was created.
